text:
jordana: Quick sync — I'm about to run a cross‑region + cross‑gpu benchmark for Llama-70B, Mistral-22B, and Qwen-14B. Primary focus: rope/GQA behavior, kernel compatibility (flash/attn kernels), and perf at ctx=8192. Starting us-west and eu-west, g4dn/g5a/a10. Will drop results here.

chris: Awesome. pls include both fp16 and 4-bit (q4f) runs and note which kernel backend used (triton vs cuda custom). Also record p50/p95 latency and tokens/s.

jordana: plan:
- command: `rbench run --model $MODEL --gpu $GPU --region $REG --ctx 8192 --quant $Q --profile kernels,latency`
- prompt set: 200 prompts (mix short/long) + long-context streaming tests
- evals: GQA/accuracy suite + hallucination subset

maya: heads up — Mistral rope implementation had that decay tweak in the upstream repo. Might see different long‑context drift vs Llama. Add a simple rope decay check (same prompt shifted by +1024 tokens).

phil: infra-bot will provision nodes. tagging @infra-bot for quota.

infra-bot: Allocated test pool: 4 x g5a.48xlarge (us-west) and 2 x a10g (eu-west). Quota remaining: 68 hours.

jordana: run 1 results (us-west, g5a, fp16):
- Llama-70B: p50=82ms, p95=198ms, throughput=210 tok/s, mem=43GB, kernels: flash_attn_v2 + custom_kv
- Mistral-22B: p50=48ms, p95=120ms, throughput=420 tok/s, mem=21GB, kernels: triton_flash + kv_shard
- Qwen-14B: p50=60ms, p95=150ms, throughput=360 tok/s, mem=25GB, kernels: cuda_attn + rope_fwd_patch
notes: Mistral wins perf on g5a for mid-size; Llama heavier mem overhead.

chris: interesting. did any model hit kernel fallback (i.e., non-flash slow path)?

jordana: Llama hit fallback at ctx>12288 for one profile due to kernel shape mismatch; got a slow CUDA fallback path. Logged kernel mismatch stack.

maya: GQA / quality quick check (same runs):
- Llama-70B: GQA acc=0.84, hallucination rate ~5%
- Mistral-22B: GQA acc=0.80, hallucination rate ~6.5%
- Qwen-14B: GQA acc=0.78, hallucination rate ~7%
Observation: Mistral's perf advantage traded off small quality delta vs Llama on reasoning tasks.

jordana: run 2 (us-west, g5a, q4f 4-bit):
- Llama-70B q4f: p50=95ms, p95=240ms, throughput=320 tok/s, mem=18GB, GQA acc drop -> 0.79
- Mistral-22B q4f: p50=55ms, p95=135ms, throughput=610 tok/s, mem=10GB, GQA acc drop -> 0.76
- Qwen-14B q4f: p50=70ms, p95=170ms, throughput=480 tok/s, mem=11GB, GQA acc drop -> 0.73
notes: quant helps throughput a lot on Mistral; Llama had larger accuracy delta on q4f.

phil: do we have kernel compatibility notes for the quant path? Some flash kernels don't support q4f layout.

jordana: yes — we hit unsupported kernel for flash_attn_v2 + q4f on Llama, fell back to `gemm` path. Documented stack trace in /tmp/rbench/1760812345-log.txt.

maya: rope/GQA long-context check (streaming with inserts):
- Llama: small drift at +6k tokens, answers degrade after ~9k
- Mistral: consistent until ~10k, then mild decay (matches repo decay tweak)
- Qwen: stable until ~8k, then sharper drop (rope encoding mismatch suspected)

jordana: region diffs (eu-west, a10g): overall +12-18ms added latency p50, throughput ~85% of us-west on same GPU class. Kernel availability on eu-west a10s: triton kernels not deployed by default -> many runs used cuda_attn slower path.

chris: So actionable items:
1) Flag kernel fallbacks per model/quant combo and blocklist combos that hit >2x p95 regression.
2) Add rope regression tests to nightly for Llama/Mistral/Qwen at ctx=16k.
3) Investigate Qwen rope patch differences w/ upstream model team.
4) Add quant kernel matrix to onboarding README.

jordana: I've opened GH issue rbench#412 with raw csv and attached perf plots (p50/p95, tokens/s, mem) + kernel markings. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbench/issues/412

eva: I'll take item 1 and 4. Can you drop the csv + kernel tag mapping into the onboarding docs?

jordana: yes will PR. Also adding a small reproduction snippet for the Llama kernel fallback:
```
# repro
rbench run --model llama-70b --gpu g5a --ctx 14000 --quant fp16 --profile kernels
# you'll see fallback: flash_attn_v2 -> cuda_gemm
```

phil: Q: do we need to patch triton kernels for a10/eu region deploys?

infra-bot: Noted. Filing infra ticket INF-987 to standardize kernel package across regions.

chris: Great thread. Let's keep this compact: jordana, paste final CSV + short summary into the thread when done (p50/p95 table + top-3 kernel fail combos). :thumbsup:

jordana: Will do. Next runs: nv4 + asia region next week to check APAC perf. Closing loop here once CSV + PR are up.
